basic_info.description: Exquisite Victorian condo in heart of Haight-Ashbury. Circa 1906, this single‐level residence offers three spacious bedrooms and a beautifully remodeled split bathroom. Soaring ceilings of ~12 feet, original hardwood floors, rich period detail throughout. Two elegant original fireplaces w/ beautiful glazed decorative tile surrounds & gas inserts. Ample windows = great natural light, incl a timeless curved bay window in the front parlor. Vintage features include dust corners, wainscoting, period motif wood detail, pocket door, decorative ceiling medallions, stained glass windows, and picture rail moulding. Kitchen: eat‐in layout w/ banquette seating, granite counters, Viking gas range, Bosch dishwasher, wine fridge, and pantry. Laundry porch just off the kitchen featuring side by side washer and dryer, provides access to the beautiful back yard. Radiant floor heating, designer shower plus a soaking tub in the bath, period lighting, custom double-paned wood windows. Extensive seismic retrofitting (completed in 2016). One-car garage parking, large deeded storage room, shared yard & garden. Positioned in the middle of an idyllic tree-lined slow street block in hip Haight-Ashbury, close to amenities incl Whole Foods, Bi-Rite, Golden Gate Park, neighborhood parks, transit.
